Title: Osney Bridge ramp diversion
Description: Thames Water maintenance works on water main and footpath structure. Temporary Thames Path diversion via Abbey Road. Scaffolding and pipe bridge across river. Works ongoing.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closure Henley
Description: Safety closure by Environment Agency. Footbridge between Henley and Shiplake closed. 2.7-3 mile diversion in place via A4155. Closure extended since Jan 2026, possibly extended further.

Title: Sandford Footbridge unsafe closure
Description: Temporary closure of unsafe footbridge north of Sandford Lock. Diversion via NCN 5 cycle path alongside railway. Investigations ongoing.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Walkway closed due to corrosion. Intermittent closures due to high river flows. Path rerouted via Abingdon town centre. Remains at risk of closure during high water levels.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure Marlow
Description: Closed May 2023 for safety (deck deterioration). Central span removed Nov 2025. Replacement will cost ~£10m. Diversion via Marlow Bridge and roads through Bisham. Closure indefinite.

Title: Bridge 142 Runnymede closure Egham
Description: Closed Feb 2024 due to tree strike damage and structural issues in cast iron structure. Diversion via A308 payements. Repair completion date unknown, funding unclear.

Title: Bell Weir Lock refurbishment diversion
Description: Thames Path diverted at Runnymede Pleasure Ground during Bell Weir refurbishment work. Temporary construction compound in place. Lock remains operational.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath erosion diversion
Description: Footpath Stre/24/1 closed due to riverbank erosion. Half-mile (0.8km) diversion via Manor Road. Repair planned but funding insufficient. Unlikely to reopen before late 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public since Feb 2025 due to widespread ash dieback disease affecting ~300 trees. Thames Path unaffected but island access prohibited. No timeline for reopening.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Closed March 2024 for safety due to structural issues. Specialist survey completed. Thames Path does not cross bridge but affects alternate routes. Repair timeline unclear.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Development work at Grand Union Canal left bank junction blocks Thames Path. No official diversion. Recommend using Brentford High Street or alternative canal route via Thames Lock.
